title: Magnetic Dirichlet Laplacian on deformed waveguides
summary: It is well known that the spectrum of the Dirichlet Laplacian for a two-dimensional waveguide, which is a local deformation of a straight strip, is unstable with respect to waveguide boundary deformations. This means that, when the waveguide is a straight strip, the spectrum of the Dirichlet Laplacian is purely essential. On the other hand, local boundary perturbations of the straight strip produce eigenvalues below the essential spectrum.
